brief:
The Palestinian Meteorology Department predicted Thursday would bring hot conditions in mountainous areas and severe heat in most regions, Shehab Wire reported. The forecast also called for a marked rise in humidity levels throughout the day.

Temperatures are expected to climb notably above their seasonal averages across Palestinian territories. The department did not specify which regions would experience the most extreme conditions or provide specific temperature readings for the day ahead.
